grains.RAW.LOAN_DAILY: one row per borrower per day (90 days)

metrics.PAR 30: 100 * SUM(OUTSTANDING_IDR WHERE DAYS_PAST_DUE > 30) / SUM(OUTSTANDING_IDR), latest day

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.miss_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(borrower misses an instalment in the next 14 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; borrowers already over 30 DPD are excluded from training and evaluation
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio missed-instalment FORECAST; e-wallet inflow ANOMALY_DETECTION per borrower (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.COLLECTION_SOP_SEARCH over 15 synthetic collection playbooks (5 products x 3 delinquency stages)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.LENDING_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.COLLECTIONS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and playbook citations; the action memo uses only KPI, borrower, product and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (borrowers, daily instalments, missed instalments by borrower, missed-instalment risk, repayment events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_REPAYMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_REPAYMENT_ALERT logs new MISSED events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
